svg.title: Four optimizers on Himmelblau's function, computed with numopt
svg.desc: Four optimizers on Himmelblau's function from x₀ = (−3.75, 2.5) to the minimizer x⋆ ≈ (−2.805, 3.131), each stopped at the first iterate with ‖∇f(xₖ)‖₂ ≤ 10⁻⁸. Iterations: Damped Newton, 5; BFGS, 8; Gradient descent (Armijo backtracking), 16; Heavy-ball momentum, 410. Right: ‖∇f(xₖ)‖₂ against k on log–log axes; Damped Newton's curve drops quadratically, heavy-ball momentum spirals into the minimizer and its gradient norm oscillates as it falls.
